name: au_search_trade_marks
description: Search Australian trade marks on the IP Australia register by word. Returns the match count first, then trade mark numbers (feed one to au_trade_mark for the full record).

name: au_trade_mark
description: Get the full public record of one Australian trade mark by trade mark number: words, kind, status, key dates, owner and address for service.

number.description: Australian trade mark number as returned by au_search_trade_marks, e.g. "69153".

name: au_search_designs
description: Search Australian registered designs on the IP Australia register by keyword. Returns the match count first, then design numbers (feed one to au_design for the full record).

name: au_design
description: Get the full public record of one Australian design by design number, including product names and statements of newness.

number.description: Australian design number as returned by au_search_designs, e.g. "201915000".

name: au_patent
description: Get the full public record of one Australian patent by application number, as published by IP Australia.
